questions.q: If a train travels 360 km in 4 hours, what is its speed?
What is the square root of 144?
questions.explain: 12 x 12 = 144, so square root of 144 is 12.

questions.q: A is twice as old as B. If A is 40 years old, how old is B?
questions.explain: If A is twice B's age and A is 40, then B = 40/2 = 20 years.

questions.q: What is 25% of 200?
If the ratio of A to B is 3:5 and B is 25, what is A?
What is the next prime number after 7?
questions.explain: 11 is the next prime number after 7 (9 is divisible by 3).

questions.q: A shopkeeper offers 20% discount on MRP of Rs 500. What is the selling price?
What is the area of a circle with radius 7 cm? (Take pi = 22/7)
questions.explain: Area = pi x r^2 = (22/7) x 7 x 7 = 154 cm2.

questions.q: If 3 workers build a wall in 6 days, how many days for 6 workers?
questions.explain: More workers = fewer days. 3 workers x 6 days = 18 worker-days. 18/6 = 3 days.

questions.q: What is the HCF of 12 and 18?
A pipe fills a tank in 12 hours. In how many hours will it fill half the tank?
What is the compound interest on Rs 1000 at 10% for 2 years?
If the perimeter of a square is 48 cm, what is its area?
What is the LCM of 4, 6 and 8?
A man walks at 5 km/h. How far does he go in 3 hours?
questions.explain: Distance = Speed x Time = 5 x 3 = 15 km.

questions.q: What is 0.75 as a fraction?
If the cost price is Rs 80 and selling price is Rs 100, what is the profit percent?
questions.explain: Profit = 100 - 80 = 20. Profit% = (20/80) x 100 = 25%. Wait, let me recalculate: (20/80)*100 = 25%.

questions.q: What is the value of sin 30 degrees?
A boat goes 20 km upstream in 5 hours and 20 km downstream in 2 hours. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.explain: Upstream speed = 20/5 = 4 km/h. Downstream speed = 20/2 = 10 km/h. Stream speed = (10-4)/2 = 3 km/h.

questions.q: What is the sum of angles in a triangle?
questions.explain: The sum of interior angles of any triangle is always 180 degrees.
